# Ghaith Mefteh — Full-Stack & Mobile Software Engineer

> Ghaith Mefteh is a full-stack and mobile software engineer based in Nabeul, Tunisia,
> with 3+ years shipping production systems end to end. He is a team lead at AzertyUI
> and is open to remote roles and freelance projects worldwide.
> Contact: ghaithmeftah@gmail.com · +216 53 32 47 63

Stack: Symfony and PHP with Doctrine and MySQL; FastAPI and Python with MongoDB;
Flutter and Dart shipped to the App Store and Google Play; React and Angular on the
front end; AWS, Docker, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions and PHPUnit around it.

He owns the whole request path — the screen in the browser, the app on the phone,
the API behind them and the database under that — rather than a single layer.

## Production work

- [chalet-montagne.com](https://www.chalet-montagne.com/): French mountain-rental marketplace rebuilt on Symfony. Search page load time cut from 20–50 s to 4–6 s, image bandwidth down about 60%, test suite built from zero to 390+ tests.
- SOC Rugby: Official Flutter app of a French rugby club, on the App Store and Google Play, past 2,000 downloads. Live results, rankings, WebSocket chat, push notifications.
- SmartCare: Healthcare platform for Tunisia — Flutter app, ReactJS web, FastAPI and MongoDB backend on AWS. Appointment booking, ambulance dispatch, push notifications.
- L-Mobile warehouse terminal: Five warehouse-management modules on forklift-mounted tablets, integrating Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central over C#/.NET and REST.
